summary.business_type: E-commerce — Lab Grown Diamond Rings (A.N. JAIN subdomain)
summary.platform: AWS EC2 (98.84.224.111) — separate from main Squarespace site
top_findings: Zero Google indexation — subdomain has never been crawled or indexed
Subdomain architecture splits already-minimal domain authority from anjain.in
Platform fragmentation: main site on Squarespace, rings subdomain on AWS EC2
quick_wins: Submit rings.anjain.in to Google Search Console immediately
Add canonical tag on subdomain pointing to authoritative URL
Create robots.txt explicitly allowing Googlebot and major AI crawlers
Consider migrating to anjain.in/rings/ subfolder to consolidate authority

findings.title: Zero Google Indexation
findings.description: site:rings.anjain.in returns zero results. The subdomain has never been crawled or indexed by Google.
findings.recommendation: Verify robots.txt allows Googlebot; create and submit XML sitemap to GSC; check for noindex meta tags; ensure page is publicly accessible

findings.title: Subdomain vs Subfolder Architecture
findings.description: Using rings.anjain.in (subdomain) instead of anjain.in/rings/ splits domain authority. Google treats subdomains as separate sites. With near-zero backlink profile on anjain.in, fragmenting authority is especially harmful.
findings.recommendation: Strongly consider migrating to www.anjain.in/rings/ or www.anjain.in/shop/rings/. If subdomain must stay, implement cross-domain canonical strategy and ensure bidirectional internal linking between domains.

findings.title: Platform Fragmentation
findings.description: Main site on Squarespace (198.49.23.144), rings subdomain on AWS EC2 (98.84.224.111). Two separate hosting environments require separate GSC properties, sitemaps, and analytics configuration.
findings.recommendation: Register rings.anjain.in as a separate GSC property. Configure unified GA4 measurement. Add sitemap reference in robots.txt.

findings.title: Canonical Tags Not Verified
findings.description: Could not verify canonical tag implementation. Without explicit canonicals, Google may deindex the subdomain or split signals with main domain ring pages.
findings.recommendation: Add self-referencing canonical on all subdomain pages: <link rel='canonical' href='https://rings.anjain.in/[page]'>

findings.title: HTTPS / Security Headers Unknown
findings.description: Could not verify TLS configuration, HSTS, CSP, or X-Frame-Options headers due to network access restriction.
findings.recommendation: Verify SSL certificate is valid; add HSTS header; configure CSP and X-Content-Type-Options

findings.title: No Indexable Content Confirmed
findings.description: No pages from this subdomain appear in Google's index. Content quality, E-E-A-T, and thin content cannot be assessed.
findings.recommendation: Ensure page is publicly accessible; add substantive keyword-targeted content (minimum 300 words); include founder credentials and sustainability angle

findings.title: E-E-A-T Signals Not Inherited
findings.description: Founder bios, brand story, and blog content on anjain.in do not flow to this subdomain. Must establish E-E-A-T independently.
findings.recommendation: Include author entity markup, gemologist credentials, IGI certification information, and brand trust signals

findings.title: Title, Meta, Headings — Unverifiable
findings.description: Could not access page to verify title tag, meta description, H1, or heading structure.
findings.recommendation: Target title: 'Lab Grown Diamond Rings India | 14K Recycled Gold | A.N. JAIN'. Meta desc: 250 chars covering lab grown, recycled gold, sustainable, price range, brand name.

findings.title: Internal Linking to Main Site
findings.description: Subdomain must link back to www.anjain.in to signal brand relationship and help users navigate to full shop.
findings.recommendation: Add prominent navigation link to www.anjain.in; add breadcrumb: anjain.in > Rings

findings.title: No Schema Confirmed
findings.description: No structured data detected (page not accessible for analysis). Missing Organization, Product/ItemList, BreadcrumbList, and WebPage schema.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization schema with sameAs to main domain and Instagram; add ItemList or Product schema for ring listings; add BreadcrumbList

findings.title: Core Web Vitals — No Field Data
findings.description: No CrUX data available (zero traffic, zero indexation). Lab data also unavailable due to network access restriction. AWS EC2 hosting with no CDN configuration assumed — could be slow without CloudFront.
findings.recommendation: After launch: run PageSpeed Insights; target LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1. Add CloudFront CDN if not already configured.

findings.title: Zero AI Citation Footprint
findings.description: Unindexed subdomain cannot appear in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Search, or Perplexity. No brand mention signals from this URL.
findings.recommendation: After indexation: add /llms.txt; ensure AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt; add structured brand signals and citability markers

findings.title: Image Optimization — Unverifiable
findings.description: Could not audit images on the subdomain. For a jewellery page, high-quality product images with descriptive alt text are essential.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all ring images have alt text: 'Samantha Ring lab grown diamond 14K recycled gold'. Use WebP/AVIF format. Explicitly set width and height attributes to prevent CLS.

phases.name: Phase 1: Make the Page Visible to Google
items: Verify the page is publicly accessible (no password, no noindex)
Create robots.txt at rings.anjain.in/robots.txt allowing all crawlers
Add /llms.txt for AI crawler discovery
Submit rings.anjain.in as a new property in Google Search Console
Submit XML sitemap to GSC
Add self-referencing canonical tags
Add bidirectional links between rings.anjain.in and www.anjain.in

phases.name: Phase 2: Authority & Architecture Decision
items: STRATEGIC DECISION: Migrate to www.anjain.in/rings/ subfolder vs keep subdomain
If keeping subdomain: establish cross-domain canonical and link equity strategy
If migrating: set up 301 redirects from rings.anjain.in/* to www.anjain.in/rings/*
Register GA4 data stream for subdomain if keeping

phases.name: Phase 3: On-Page SEO & Schema
items: Optimize title tag: 'Lab Grown Diamond Rings | 14K Recycled Gold | A.N. JAIN'
Write meta description targeting 'lab grown diamond rings india' (155 chars)
Add H1 with primary keyword, H2s for ring categories/features
Inject Organization + ItemList/Product JSON-LD schema
Add BreadcrumbList schema
Optimize all product images: descriptive alt text, WebP, explicit dimensions

phases.name: Phase 4: Performance & Monitoring
items: Run PageSpeed Insights once page is live
Configure CloudFront CDN if AWS EC2 serving raw
Monitor GSC for first indexation (target: within 7–14 days of submission)
Set up GA4 organic traffic tracking
Monitor Core Web Vitals in GSC after first 28-day data window
